title: Learn the application's purpose and language
statement: As a newcomer, I can learn the application's purpose and project language in one place, so that I can understand discussions and source code sooner.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The overview presents the application name, pitch, description, and terms.
Each term provides a name, definition, and aliases.
Each term links to the stories and code it describes.
A story or source location lists the terms it defines.
A term warns the reader when its linked code no longer matches.
A comparison suggests newly introduced domain vocabulary as optional documentation growth.
The overview lets a newcomer open each feature's product, design, quality, and implementation material.
Retired product knowledge is separated from the current application view.
